# LP Skills

Portable Agent Skills for Uniswap and Aerodrome liquidity provision.

## Install

npx skills add galleonlabs/lp-skills
npm install --global galleon-lp-skills

## Skill entrypoints

- skills/lp-research/SKILL.md: compare pools and assess risk before deployment
- skills/lp-plan/SKILL.md: produce an exact unsigned position plan
- skills/lp-monitor/SKILL.md: inspect a live position and decide whether action is justified
- skills/lp-operate/SKILL.md: execute an explicitly requested action through a user-controlled wallet
- skills/lp-engineer/SKILL.md: build and review protocol integrations

## Machine interfaces

- package: galleon-lp-skills
- CLI: lp-skills
- discovery schema: https://schemas.agentskills.io/discovery/0.2.0/schema.json
- source: https://github.com/galleonlabs/lp-skills
